entries.question: Appointment lena h
entries.answer:
To take an appointment, please follow these steps:

1.  **Online Registration:** Online registration is mandatory for all patients.
2.  **Appointment Booking:** You can book your appointment through any of the following methods:
    *   **Website:** www.ors.gov.in (you can access this via mobile internet)
    *   **Phone:** Call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333
    *   **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT <Your Name>" to 8887019134

Please remember to bring a printed copy of your appointment or the confirmation SMS when you visit.

entries.question: Sir DMLT course me admission kaise mil sakta hai
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU) offers diploma courses in paramedical sciences. To get admission into the DMLT (Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician) course, you need to follow the admission process outlined by the university.

For detailed information regarding eligibility criteria, application procedures, important dates, and the selection process for the DMLT course, please visit the official KGMU website: [https://kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php](https://kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php)

You can also refer to the "Instructions and checklist of Mandatory Documents for Paramedical admission Batch 2024-25" which might be available on the KGMU website for the most current admission guidelines.

entries.question: Opd me kaise dikhaya jaye
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU) mein OPD mein dikhane ke liye, aapko online registration karna hoga. Yahan kuch tareeke diye gaye hain:

1.  **Website dwara:** Aap www.ors.gov.in par jaakar online appointment book kar sakte hain.
2.  **Phone dwara:** Aap 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call karke appointment le sakte hain.
3.  **SMS dwara:** Aap "APPOINTMENT <APKA NAAM>" likhkar 8887019134 par SMS bhej sakte hain.

Dhyan rahe ki OPD ka samay subah 9 baje se dopahar 2 baje tak hai. Apne appointment ki printed copy ya SMS saath laana na bhoolein.

Agar aap kisi khaas department ke bare mein janna chahte hain, to kripya department ka naam batayein.
entries.ai_question_translated_en: Opd me how dikhaya jaye

entries.question: Kya ivf suvidha uplabdh hai
entries.answer:
Ji haan, KGMU mein IVF suvidha uplabdh hai. Yeh suvidha Obstetrics & Gynecology vibhag ke antargat aati hai.

Aap adhik jaankari ke liye Obstetrics & Gynecology vibhag se sampark kar sakte hain ya unki website par jaa sakte hain:

*   **Department Link:** [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=20&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=20&dept_type=2)

Vibhag se sampark karne ke liye aap unke diye gaye phone number ya email address ka upyog kar sakte hain jo unki department page par uplabdh honge.
